sources.title: Avs defenseman Cale Makar signs richest deal in NHL history at $163.2 million over 8 years
sources.description: “I couldn’t be more excited to continue my journey here with the Avalanche in this amazing city of Denver,” Makar said in a video posted on social media by the team, calling it a historic day.
